title: Initial Coverage Initiated: CNK (Severely Overvalued / Extreme Valuation Disconnect)
trigger_reason: Genesis research completed by Gemini 3.6 Flash.
what_changes_now: At the prompt's benchmark price of $100.00, Cinemark trades at an unsustainable 16.8x EV/EBITDA and 35.2x Owner Earnings, presenting a massive 55% downside to its intrinsic base-case valuation of $45.00 per share. While operational execution is world-class—highlighted by Q2 2026 revenue surpassing $1.086B for the first time in company history—the $100.00 price embeds an unachievable hyper-growth scenario that ignores theatrical box office structural ceilings and real economic debt burdens.
